title: Chapter 867
paragraphs: Chapter 867
216. The First Golden Ship (3)
"...Even after experiencing death once, how can you be so foolish? It was my mistake. I should have sent you, not those five, to the tomb of Phaethel."
The Sun Priestess, Sanna, was regretting after confirming the last moments of the priests who went to capture Phaethel.
The sight of them through her prayers was unbelievably foolish. Especially shocking was Tuzard, who made the wrong choice even at the cost of his and other priests' immortality.
"The five were enough to capture Phaethel. They just handled the variables badly."
A priest beside her shook his head and spoke. He was also an old powerhouse who resurrected like Tuzard's party, a member of the Demon King tribe.
"But we also have a history of failing to capture Shinu, so we can't mock them too much."
"You can't compare Phaethel with Shinu. My judgement was wrong at Shinu's time too. If I had sent Priest Luke to Shinu sooner, we wouldn't have missed him."

The priest's name was Luke, who was once revered as a warrior of the Demon King tribe. As Shinu had mentioned to Jin before, the priesthood of the Sun Church included former members of the Demon King tribe.
"You blame yourself a lot these days. You seem anxious, priestess."
"It's because the future I confirm through prayers is constantly being disrupted. The return of the powerful figures from Runcandel, starting with White Whale, at this time was truly unexpected."
"Probably because a man named Chiron keeps transcending fate. That's why the predestined futures keep going astray."
"Right. The shift of Phaethel's power to Jin Runcandel is also a chain reaction of such things. How that will further affect things..."
Sanna had been having frustrating days lately.
Her goal was the resurrection of the Sun God.
To achieve that, both the surface and the underground worlds must experience destruction, or near destruction, at the right time.
And the sooner that time comes, the better, but looking at the overall situation of the world now, it seemed difficult.
A fierce battle was expected. Plus, Elona, who was expected to destroy everything upon awakening from the seal, was bleating like a tame sheep.
"But as the variables have increased, the time when our priests can act in the mortal world is also advancing."
"That's true. Once the transition of the underworld ends, it will be easier for Priest Luke and the other priests to manifest."

For Sanna, that was the only comforting aspect. Regardless of how the war between the underworld and the surface world progressed, Sanna planned to use the priests to adjust the direction as the Sun Church wanted.
The priests possess such power.
"I wonder who we'll fight first among the Vamel Alliance, the Lutero Federation, Kinzelo, the Demon King tribe, or the Underworld. It piques my curiosity."
"We'll fight with the force that first gains the upper hand. Right now, the answer to my prayers is unclear, but I think the Underworld is most likely."
"Maybe, but I'm certain that the Vamel Alliance will ultimately be the biggest obstacle to the Sun Church's aspiration."
"Because of Chiron Runcandel?"

"No, Jin Runcandel. He became a Demon King with a human body, and now he's the successor of the current War God. Plus, he has the power of Solderet... If he is completed through this war, all factions will have to look up to him. Even our Sun Church."
"It's surprising that Priest Luke would evaluate him so highly."
"Of course, we have to adjust well to make sure that doesn't happen. Until then, it's best to focus on capturing Shinu and waking up other brothers."
"I agree. If Zipple completes the Magic Stone as soon as possible, we'll be able to take it."
Just as Sanna answered, Luke suddenly glanced at her with surprise.
"Ho-ho, priestess. Did you feel it?"
"What do you mean?"
"Just now, somewhere in the mortal world... a being of our kind has awakened. It's not one of Jin Runcandel's brothers, as its energy is subtly different from ours, the Demon King tribe."
Soon, Luke added with a smirk.
"The Azure Tribe... Our Demon King tribe's ancestors, and it seems to be a War God among them."
Middle World, the ancient city of the Azure tribe, Nilot.
Amir Vermont looked at Eltieht who had just emerged from the maintenance device.
"Eltieht, do you recognize me?"
"You are... Ailan. The one who saved me. Saved me and my brothers..."
A satisfied smile appeared on Ailan's face.

He and the royal family had never saved Eltieht and the Azure tribe. At that time, they didn't have enough power. The royal family merely took care of the sealed physical bodies of Eltieht and the Azure tribe.
They used the buried Azure tribesmen in trade with the Demon King tribe and in researching and experimenting with biological golems.
They kept implying to the sealed Eltieht over that long period of time. They kept implying that they were the ones who saved the Azure tribe from being destroyed by the great seal.
And that the enemy of the royal family was also the enemy of the Azure tribe.
"That's right. Unfortunately, we could only save a few of your brothers... but seeing you awake now, I feel relieved."
"...Why is it filled with the scent of the red ones who should be torn and killed, rather than my brothers? The stench of insignificant demons is also present."
At those words, Ailan smiled inwardly once more.
What he liked most of all was that Eltieht, while having lost his memory, still possessed a terrible power, just like in the old times. Just like Elona Zipple.

"More time has passed than you can imagine, Eltieht. And now it's an era where the Demon King tribe and the demons are gaining power. Let's get up and meet your brothers. I will explain everything slowly when we get there."
Eltieht, with a vacant gaze, took the hand that Ailan extended.
December 30, 1803.
Since then, Runcandel has been dealing with transition fissures, dedicating his days to the completion of the Golden Ship.
"Tonight's the night."
The completion of Ayula's Advent Ceremony, and the night when the Vamel Alliance gets their first Golden Ship. All the news will arrive tonight.
'And the transition to the Underworld begins tonight.'
There were about fifty fissures formed in Hufes currently.

Even the efforts of those who could remove the fissures, including Jin, Luna, and Luntia, were stretched thin. The fact that all the fissures in key areas like Shiatelro have been removed was a small relief.
"King, is it true that the evacuation from the fissure areas has been perfectly completed?"

"Yes, Jin. Not only people but also the livestock and pets they were raising have all been relocated. There is not a single person who couldn't evacuate, Valeria Yang has confirmed it with record magic for the entire area."
According to what the Nameless and the Seven Colored Bird had figured out, the Lutero Federation had several times more transition fissures left than the Vamel Alliance.
"That's a relief."
"As long as the remaining fissures in Zipple don't become a communication window with the Underworld, we should be able to lead the war quite advantageously."
If Zipple couldn't ally with the Underworld, it would be the worst situation for them.
They were already at war with the Demon King tribe in various places of the federation, and if the Underworld joined, even Zipple would be helpless.
'If Zipple and the Underworld form an alliance, Sanna would certainly be at the center of it.'
Jin recalled the priests who made Shinu struggle in the Sun Church.

"Shinu is from the ancestors of the Demon King tribe... Even those who appear as the Fighting God became priests of the Sun Church, he said. There's no way that the Tojad and his crew we met this time could have pushed a god like Shinu so far. It's not a lie that the Demon King tribe is involved."
It was unpleasant that the past Demon King tribes, who had become the Sun Church, could reveal themselves to the world before his brothers trapped in Lafrarosa.

'If the Underworld forms a temporary alliance with Zipple, burdened by the power of Elona Zipple and Sanna, and the magic stones of the Underworld, the situation would be reversed in an instant. We would be at a disadvantage.'
In that sense, securing Phaitel this time was truly a heavenly luck. If they hadn't found him, even after the day had passed, the first Golden Ship wouldn't have been completed.
"I think we should go to the Sacred Kingdom. I'll go with Murakan."

Although there are many more transition fissures in areas other than the Sacred Kingdom, Jin, as the head of the Vamel Alliance, needed to directly confirm Ayula's revelation and personally encourage the citizens of the Sacred Kingdom.
"Please go, Sir. If there is a problem with the fissure, I will immediately request communication to the Sacred Kingdom."
Jin and Murakan rode the Red Owl and left for the Sacred Kingdom.
And as everyone expected, the upheaval began at night.
{[King, the demons and buildings of the Underworld have started to be summoned from the fissures in Hufes.]}
At 10 PM, Leuth put in a communication to Tikan. Runcandel's riders and knights were already heading to each fissure.
"I will notify Sir Jin immediately, and I will send the superhumans in Tikan."
{[Please send the superhumans in Tikan to the Empire, not Hufes. A new fissure has suddenly formed near all the capitals of the Empire, and demons are being summoned from there right now.]}
Of course, the Empire had already evacuated all the civilians in the fissure area. But the newly formed fissure without warning was the problem.
{[The Archduke will soon send Mort to there......]}
The moment Leuth said that, a new communication came in from the Empire.
It was a communication from the 'Golden Ship', not Dante's Hairan 2nd Fortress.
{Hahaha! Don't worry about the Empire!}
"Dr. Qwaul...?"

{I and Phaitel just arrived at Hairan 2nd Fortress driving the Golden Ship. All the checks are done, and the current state of the Golden Ship is perfect. I've already turned a thousand demons from the fissure into dust with one shot of the ship's cannon. So, when the Archduke arrives, tell him to go elsewhere, not the capital. The Golden Emperor and we will protect the capital!}

The demons that emerged from the fissure near the imperial capital, most of them were encountering death without even being able to take in the landscape of this world that they were so curious about.
